title: BAE Falcon Works joint ventures with Lockheed Skunk Works

tellings.quote: BAE has Falcon Works that is BAE's version of skunk works and BAE has joint ventures with Lockheed with skunk works on material sciences on engineering on engines on all of it.

plain: BAE Systems, a large British defence company, has a secret projects division called Falcon Works, its "version of Skunk Works," the advanced projects arm of the American aerospace firm Lockheed Martin, and the two run joint ventures "on material sciences, on engineering, on engines, on all of it." That is what Dylan Borland, a former US intelligence employee turned whistleblower, says from his own experience. If true, it would mean that secret aerospace work is shared across companies in two countries.
